description: Dept. of Trade and Investment Policy - Import duties on Petroleum Oils. - R. P..O No. 09/2018
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a resolution passed by Parliament under Section 10 of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that modifies import duty rates on specific petroleum products. It establishes new regulatory requirements for customs duties, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning the modification of existing regulations rather than government personnel or structural changes.
